# axm_webhook_deliveries (Data Source)

Fetches delivery history for an Apple Business Manager webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "axm_webhook_deliveries" "example" {
  webhook_id = "webhook-12345"
}

output "webhook_deliveries" {
  value = data.axm_webhook_deliveries.example.deliveries
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `webhook_id` (String) The ID of the webhook whose deliveries are fetched.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `deliveries` (Attributes List) The webhook's deliveries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deliveries))
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--deliveries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deliveries`

Read-Only:

- `created_date_time` (String) The date and time the delivery was created.
- `delivery_state` (String) The delivery state: SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or PENDING.
- `error_message` (String) The error message, if delivery failed.
- `event_id` (String) The ID of the event associated with the delivery.
- `id` (String) The delivery ID.
- `redelivery` (Boolean) Whether this delivery is a redelivery.
- `request_url` (String) The webhook URL to which the delivery was sent.
- `response_body` (String) The response body returned by the webhook endpoint.
- `response_http_status_code` (Number) The HTTP status code returned by the webhook endpoint.
- `sent_date_time` (String) The date and time the delivery was sent.
